gloss: mass retailer; discount store; volume seller

definitions.gloss: mass retailer; discount store; volume seller
definitions.explanation: A retail store that sells goods in large quantities at competitive prices. In Japan, this term is especially associated with large electronics stores and home improvement centers.

examples.japanese: {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a TV at an electronics mass retailer.

examples.japanese: {量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Mass retailers are popular because their prices are low.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小売店|こうりてん}→小売店：20689_kouriten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A large mass retailer opened near the station, affecting the surrounding small shops.

notes:
A store that sells products in high volume at discounted prices. Composed of ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (volume/quantity) + {販|はん} (sell) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (store).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん}: electronics mass retailer (e.g., Yamada Denki, Bic Camera)
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{量販店|りょうはんてん}: large-scale mass retailer
- {量販店|りょうはんてん}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: mass-retailer price

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小売店|こうりてん}→小売店：20689_kouriten⟧: retail store — general term for any shop that sells to consumers
- ⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧: specialty store — focuses on one category of products
- ⟦{百貨店|ひゃっかてん}→百貨店：18639_hyakkaten⟧: department store — upscale, multi-floor store with a wide range of goods
- ディスカウントストア: discount store — a loanword alternative, though {量販店|りょうはんてん} is more common in Japanese

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {家電|かでん}{量販店|りょうはんてん} (electronics mass retailers) like Yamada Denki, Bic Camera, and Yodobashi Camera are major shopping destinations. They often feature point-card reward systems and aggressive price competition.
